definitions.explanation: The essential knowledge needed as a foundation before learning more advanced topics or performing a task.

examples.japanese: {基礎|きそ}{知識|ちしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧。
⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧{基礎|きそ}{知識|ちしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{理解|りかい}できない→理解する：06059_rikaisuru⟧。
examples.english: You can't understand it without basic knowledge first.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦プログラミング→プログラミング：06099_puroguramingu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{基礎|きそ}{知識|ちしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦わかりやすく→わかりやすい：09582_wakariyasui⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}している→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
examples.english: This book explains the fundamentals of programming in an easy-to-understand way.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{基礎|きそ}→基礎：03981_kiso⟧ (foundation, basics) and ⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧ (knowledge). Refers to the minimum knowledge needed to engage with a subject, skill, or profession. Commonly used in educational and professional contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {基礎|きそ}{知識|ちしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧: to acquire basic knowledge
- {基礎|きそ}{知識|ちしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧: to learn the basics
- {基礎|きそ}{知識|ちしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have basic knowledge
- {基礎|きそ}{知識|ちしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧: to lack basic knowledge

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{予備|よび}{知識|ちしき}→予備知識：17945_yobichishiki⟧: prerequisite knowledge — knowledge needed before tackling a specific topic
- ⟦{常識|じょうしき}→常識：03287_joushiki⟧: common sense — general knowledge expected of adults in society
- ⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧: basics — broader term for fundamentals, not limited to knowledge
